enriched_activities.activity: Working a night shift as an aged-care support worker at the residential care facility, assisting residents with overnight personal care, repositioning and documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to resident's room. Turn on light. Greet resident. Assist resident to sit up. Help resident to bathroom. Assist with toileting. Help resident back to bed. Reposition resident onto side. Adjust pillow. Check skin. Apply lotion. Turn resident onto back. Cover with blanket. Turn off light. Walk to nursing station. Open log book. Write care notes. Wash hands. Repeat for next resident.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the care facility by train and bus, checking text messages and reviewing the shift handover notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to train station. Wait on platform. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Open messaging app. Read text messages. Type reply. Send reply. Put phone away. Take out handover notes. Read notes. Underline important points. Put notes away. Get off train. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Check phone again. Get off bus. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a light post-shift breakfast of toast and fruit and brewing a cup of tea, keeping noise to a minimum
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open fridge. Take out bread. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Take out fruit. Wash fruit. Cut fruit. Put fruit on plate. Open cupboard. Take out mug. Take out tea bag. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Wait for kettle to boil. Pour water into mug. Add tea bag. Stir. Sit at table. Eat toast. Eat fruit. Drink tea. Wash dishes. Put dishes in drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing after the night shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap to sponge. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around waist. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping after the night shift with the fan on and the light off, recovering in quiet conditions
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Close door. Turn off light. Turn on fan. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping. Wake briefly. Turn to other side. Adjust fan speed. Continue sleeping. Wake up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple flexitarian lunch of rice and vegetables in the rice cooker and eating it with a cup of tea
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open cupboard. Take out rice cooker. Open rice bag. Scoop rice into bowl. Wash rice. Drain water. Put rice into rice cooker. Add water. Close lid. Press cook button. Open fridge. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Open rice cooker. Put vegetables on top of rice. Close lid. Wait. Open rice cooker. Scoop rice and vegetables onto plate. Sit at table. Pick up spoon. Eat. Pick up cup. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry and running a load in the washing machine, then hanging and drying the clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Open laundry basket. Sort clothes into light and dark piles. Pick up light pile. Walk to washing machine. Open washing machine door. Put clothes in. Add detergent. Close door. Turn dial to set cycle. Press start button. Wait for cycle to finish. Open door. Take out clothes. Pick up laundry basket. Walk to drying rack. Hang clothes on rack. Adjust clothes. Pick up empty basket. Walk back to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting at the desk under the desk lamp, reading set social work course readings on the computer and monitor and taking detailed written notes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Press computer power button. Turn on monitor. Log in. Open browser. Navigate to course readings. Open PDF. Scroll down. Read. Pick up pen. Write notes in notebook. Underline key points. Highlight text. Scroll up. Re-read. Write more notes. Close PDF. Check email.

enriched_activities.activity: Volunteering at the animal shelter, walking dogs and cleaning the kennels during the public holiday volunteer session
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at animal shelter. Sign in at front desk. Walk to kennel area. Pick up leash. Open kennel door. Attach leash to dog collar. Walk dog outside. Walk around shelter grounds. Stop to let dog sniff. Continue walking. Return to kennel. Remove leash. Put dog back in kennel. Pick up hose. Spray kennel floor. Scrub with brush. Rinse. Squeegee water. Refill water bowl. Put hose away. Sign out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home by bus and train from the animal shelter
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Put phone away. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off train. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Buying and unpacking a small cash-budgeted grocery shop of vegetables, lentils, eggs and tea, then cooking a flexitarian dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter grocery store. Pick up basket. Walk to produce section. Select vegetables. Put in basket. Walk to dry goods. Select lentils. Put in basket. Walk to dairy. Select eggs. Put in basket. Walk to tea aisle. Select tea. Put in basket. Walk to checkout. Pay cashier. Pick up bags. Walk home. Enter kitchen. Unpack groceries. Put vegetables in fridge. Put lentils in cupboard. Put eggs in fridge. Put tea in cupboard. Open fridge. Take out ingredients for dinner. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add lentils. Add water. Cover. Simmer.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the kitchen table and drinking tea
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at kitchen table. Pick up fork. Pierce vegetables. Lift fork to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Repeat. Pick up cup. Sip tea. Put cup down. Continue eating. Finish meal. Push plate away. Pick up cup. Drink remaining tea. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up the dishes and loading the dishwasher, wiping down the shared benches
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into bin. Stack plates. Carry to sink. Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Pick up sponge. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Wash utensils. Rinse. Place in dishwasher. Pick up cloth. Wipe kitchen bench. Wipe table. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Writing out reminders and a to-do list for the coming week, reviewing the weekly budget and checking the roster on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open notebook. Pick up pen. Write reminders. Write to-do list. Put pen down. Pick up phone. Open banking app. Check balance. Open budget spreadsheet. Review expenses. Close app. Open roster app. Check shifts. Note shifts in notebook. Put phone down. Close notebook.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on a social work assignment at the desk, typing on the computer with the monitor on and the desk lamp lit
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open word processor. Open assignment file. Type paragraph. Scroll up. Read. Delete sentence. Type new sentence. Check word count. Open reference document. Copy citation. Paste into assignment. Save file. Continue typing. Pause. Read over text. Type more. Save again.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening wash and brushing teeth before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Pick up face cloth. Wet face cloth. Wipe face. Rinse face cloth. Hang face cloth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Drinking a cup of tea, looking at the photo of his family dog in China and reading quietly with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up mug. Sip tea. Put mug on bedside table. Pick up photo frame. Look at photo. Put photo back. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read next page. Close book. Pick up mug. Sip tea. Put mug down. Turn on fan. Lie down.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, aiming to reset a regular sleep pattern after the rotating night shifts
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping. Turn to other side. Adjust fan. Continue sleeping.
